purpose: Regenerate a same-source PEMS H96 baseline matrix for the fixed resource-qualified d32 full-coverage MambaTS v3 candidate.
research_question: Under a single source snapshot and matched optimization budget, is the d32 MambaTS v3 AutoCon candidate non-inferior to strong PEMS baselines while retaining its measured low-latency advantage over Mamba/patch/periodic comparators?
selection_history: Candidate geometry was frozen before this screen: patch_len=24, patch_stride=24, d_model=32, d_ff=64, d_state=8, d_conv=2, expand=1, context_rank=8, AutoCon lambda=0.001. No outcome from this screen may change it.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. Test data are not evaluated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: Only a complete, provenance-valid matrix can authorize a separately reviewed multi-horizon validation plan; it cannot itself support a held-out-test or publication claim.
prelaunch_gates: verify PEMS03/04/07/08 hashes, axes, and train-only normalization
freeze d32 candidate, exact lambda-zero control, comparator set, seeds, and budget
verify all baseline and MambaTS v3 runtime contracts
require exact dataset-horizon-seed pairing before any analysis

phases.name: pems_h96_d32_strong_baselines
phases.purpose: Matched DLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, and TimeMixer references.

phases.name: pems_h96_d32_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact MambaTS v3 d32 graph with lambda zero.

phases.name: pems_h96_d32_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact MambaTS v3 d32 graph with the fixed active AutoCon weight.

primary_contrasts: active versus each same-snapshot strong baseline
comparison_contract.noninferiority_margin: 0.02 relative validation MSE per dataset against the best baseline
comparison_contract.resource_contract: Use a fresh identical batch/input/hardware forward protocol after accuracy validation; distinguish latency from end-to-end training time.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No test-set, cross-horizon, universal-speed, or stable-AutoCon-benefit claim is permitted from this screen.

stopping_rules: Do not change architecture, lambda, seeds, budget, or comparator set after launch.
If active is more than 2% worse than the best same-snapshot baseline on two or more dataset means, do not release a test evaluation.
If active/null is not directionally reproducible, do not claim a causal AutoCon accuracy benefit.
Do not release test metrics from this matrix.
